text:
Jenna: Heads-up: a group of external auditors (three people) are arriving at 09:15. They'll likely bring a stack of binders and one rolling suitcase. Can someone confirm space to stage these without blocking the walkway? :briefcase:

FrontDeskBot: Delivery notice logged: 'External auditors / compliance'  items: 3 binders + 1 suitcase. Recommended staging: alcove near stairwell or back counter. Photo attached. :ledger:

Carlos: I can meet them and take the binders to the back counter. Do we want them to sign the visitor log or use temporary badges?

Jenna: Please have them sign the visitor log and use sticker badges for the morning. Badge printer is working but queue is long. Also note: alcove near stairwell is being used for storage until 10:00, so back counter is best.

Aisha: I'll re-route the stackable chairs out of Meeting Pod C to make a small holding area if needed. Would help if they want to sort papers before heading to MR1.

Liam: FYI mail room has a large cardboard box pile today. If auditors want to leave any packaging behind, ops policy says remove same-day. MailRoomBot: Temporary holding allowed until EOD with Ops approval.

MailRoomBot: Parcel room status: 78% capacity. Alert threshold at 90%. Suggest immediate recycling of empty boxes.

Jenna: Sounds good. Carlos please escort them to the back counter, give them sticker badges (name/company/time), and ask them to sign the compliance visitor form. Aisha thanks for the chairs offer  we might need them briefly. 

Carlos: On it. Quick question  where's the compliance visitor form? I only see the standard visitor sign-in.

Jenna: It's in the locked top drawer labeled 'compliance' at reception. Key on lanyard hook next to the phone. If you can't find it ping me and I'll come down.

Carlos: Found it, thanks. Also told them packaging must be removed today or we'll dispose after EOD unless they ask us to keep it. They nodded.

FrontDeskBot: Check-in complete: 3 auditors signed in at 09:12, sticker badges issued. Delivery staged on back counter. Reminder: escort beyond secure doors.

Aisha: Chairs moved to Pod C. If they need a place to spread binders we can set up MR1 at 09:30. 

Liam: Noted re: mail room capacity. I'll clear two large boxes for recycling after lunch to free up space. 

Jenna: Thank you everyone  looks like smooth sailing. If auditors need extended staging beyond today, escalate to Ops. :thumbsup:
